data.long_meaning: The meaning of Nicolis is recorded in name-lists as “Victory of the people”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nicolis expresses “Victory of the people”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nicolis total 36, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
